newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Autlan agrees to option mine property.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Autlan agrees to option mine property.

text.p: Mexican specialist miner Compania Minera Autlan said Tuesday it had agreed to option its wholly-owned Luficer Mine property in Mexico to Copperstone Resources Corp..

The mine, located in Santa Rosalia in the state of Baja California Sur, is within Copperstone's optioned Lucifer concession and contains primarily copper and cobalt. Copperstone is a Canadian exploration company.

"The agreement calls for the payment of $2.7 million over three years. Copperstone will also issue 400,000 shares to Autlan and pay Autlan a 2 percent smelter royalty on production from both the Luficer mine and the Luficer Concession (the Combined Properties)," Autlan said.

The royalty is capped at $4 million with a $250,000 annual minimum once commercial production is achieved. "After feasibility study, Autlan may participate as to 10 percent in a mining operation on the Combined Properties by contributing 10 percent of mine development costs or elect to receive 6.25 percent net profits interest at no cost," it added.
Autlan said it had also been granted the right to match any offer of production financing received by Copperstone and to match any takeover offer supported by management from third parties.

"Autlan also has received the right to appoint a representative to Copperstone's board of directors and retains the exclusive right to market any ore-grade manganese dioxide discovered on the Combined Property," it added.
Autlan, based in the northern city of Monterrey, said an application for an exploration permit is being filed.
On receipt, Copperstone plans to resume immediately its drilling program, modifying its original plan to cover the prospective portion of the Combined Property.

Copperstone has agreed with Autlan that it will spend a minimum $1 million on the Combined Properties during 1997. "Autlan's management believes that if exploration results are positive, this project could make a very significant contribution to the company's earnings," it added.
